The strongest chokepoint logic in this node appears to be upstream and midstream: specialty alloys, titanium/nickel inputs, aerospace fasteners, engine subcomponents, and certified precision manufacturing rather than prime contractors.

DCO should remain in the underfollowed lane as a niche aerospace/defense engineered-products and subassembly supplier; survival to later layers requires facility-level AS9100/NADCAP evidence, prime-program exposure, and raw-material domestic-content verification.

CRS and ATI are stronger as reference/context anchors for titanium, nickel, superalloy and specialty-material bottlenecks than as underfollowed alpha names because both are now large-cap stocks, but their direct material exposure is high.

Need a focused pass on U.S.-listed sub-$5B forging, casting, fastener, precision-machining, aerospace bearings, specialty coating, heat-treatment and testing/certification companies with disclosed GE Aerospace, RTX, Boeing, Lockheed, Safran or military-engine exposure.

node: Domestic-content aerospace and defense components: castings, forgings, precision machining, alloys, fasteners, and engine subcomponents
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expanded the direct public-company universe around domestic-content aerospace and defense components. The reference lane is anchored by Howmet as the most obvious public pure-play supplier of aero-engine, fastener, forging, casting, titanium, and structural products. The underfollowed lane highlights ATI and RBC Bearings as larger but less thematically crowded suppliers with direct aerospace materials/component exposure, and SIFCO as a micro-cap speculative exception with unusually direct evidence of titanium/aluminum/high-temperature-alloy aerospace component capability plus AS9100/NADCAP credentials. The node remains a hypothesis: policy, tariff, Buy American, and defense-supply-chain scrutiny could reroute share toward already-qualified domestic or compliant suppliers, but company-level domestic-content advantage still needs verification in filings, customer awards, and sourcing disclosures.
